create_trainer: create a Trainer instance with custom accelerator, strategy, devices, precision, and checkpoint settings
fit_module: fit a Module with train and validation dataloaders using the Trainer's fit method
run_train_loop: run a single training epoch with gradient accumulation, clipping, and scheduler stepping
run_val_loop: run a single validation epoch on the module with the validation dataloader
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint to the checkpoint directory with optional probe weights only mode
